_readme: Image manifest. Every image used on the site is listed here with its source, licence and attribution. Pages refer to images by key. 'kind': 'illustration-placeholder' marks original artwork that should be replaced by real, licensed photography. To add a photo: put responsive WebP files at <src>-<width>.webp, set kind to 'photo', and fill source, licence and attribution. See docs/CONTENT_GUIDE.md.
